criterion.title: Context Awareness - Follow-up Understanding
criterion.given: I asked "What is your refund policy?" AND the system responded with information about 30-day refunds
criterion.then: AI understands this refers to the refund policy (not a generic question) AND provides context-aware answer about extended refund terms AND I don't have to repeat the topic

criterion.title: Context Window Management - Last 10 Messages
criterion.given: I am in an active chat conversation
criterion.then: system maintains context from the last 10 messages AND older messages are progressively de-emphasized (not deleted) AND context window size is configurable per bot (default: 10)

criterion.title: Context Window Management - Summarization
criterion.given: the conversation has more than 10 messages
criterion.then: system summarizes older messages into a brief context paragraph AND passes both the summary + last 10 messages to the LLM AND the user doesn't see the summarization process

criterion.title: Context Reset - Start New Conversation
criterion.then: conversation history is cleared AND a new empty chat window appears AND the next message is treated as a fresh query (no prior context)

criterion.title: Context Reset - Session Isolation
criterion.given: I close and reopen the chat window
criterion.when: I return to the same bot
criterion.then: the previous conversation context is NOT retained (session-based) AND I start fresh in a new session AND conversation history is cleared from storage

criterion.title: LLM Integration - Context Prepending
criterion.when: the query is sent to the LLM
criterion.then:
system prepends previous messages to the prompt in structure: ## Conversation Context
User: [msg]
Assistant: [response]

## Current Question
User: [query] AND the LLM uses this structure to generate contextual responses

criterion.title: LLM Integration - Citation Relevance
criterion.given: context is being used for a query
criterion.then: citations reference the current query context (not prior context) AND the user sees citations relevant to their latest question

criterion.title: Performance - Large Context Handling
criterion.then: system efficiently summarizes without delays AND LLM response time is not degraded (< 3s for streaming start)

criterion.title: Performance - File Attachment References
criterion.given: a message contains a file attachment or image (future feature)
criterion.then: file references are preserved in the summary AND the LLM can reference them

criterion.title: Error Handling - Graceful Fallback
criterion.then: system falls back to treating it as a standalone query AND a warning is logged (not shown to user) AND the chat continues normally

artifact.title: Epic & Story Breakdown
artifact.section: Epic 4: Chat Experience, Story 4.2: Conversation Context
artifact.snippet: End-user wants the chat to remember conversation so they can ask follow-up questions naturally. Conversation context is passed to RAG pipeline. Context window is limited to last 10 messages. Clearing conversation resets context.
artifact.relevance: Complete story specification and acceptance criteria for context management

artifact.title: Web Chat Interface
artifact.section: Story 4.1 Chat Interface and Session History
artifact.snippet: Chat history is stored in browser localStorage (session-based). Messages survive page refresh within same session. Chat history is cleared when closing browser tab.
artifact.relevance: Provides foundation for message storage and session management that Story 4.2 extends

artifact.title: Context-Only Answer Generation
artifact.snippet: LLM enforces context-only answers with structured prompts. Temperature set to 0.1 for determinism. Response streamed token-by-token. Response time < 3s for first token.
artifact.relevance: Provides LLM integration patterns that context service must work with

artifact.title: System Architecture
artifact.section: Frontend: Next.js 14, Backend: FastAPI, Streaming Patterns
artifact.snippet: Frontend: Next.js 14 (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui. Backend: FastAPI with async patterns. SSE streaming for real-time token delivery.
artifact.relevance: Architecture confirms tech stack and streaming patterns for context-aware responses

artifact.title: Technical Specification
artifact.snippet: Frontend: Next.js 14 (App Router), TypeScript. Backend: FastAPI (Python 3.11+). LLM: Ollama with Qwen 2.5. Streaming via SSE.
artifact.relevance: Confirms tech stack for hooks, components, and LLM integration patterns

constraints.constraint: Context stored only in-flight (in-memory session) and client-side localStorage. NO persistent database storage of conversation context (privacy-first design).
Context window default 10 messages, configurable per bot (max 100). Context summarization only triggered when > context_window.
Summarization strategy can be simple (topic extraction) or smart (LLM-based). Start with simple, upgrade to smart if needed.
Context isolation: Ensure context is never shared across users, bots, or tenants. Always filter by tenant_id and bot_id.
Injection prevention: Sanitize context before passing to LLM. Escape special characters that could break prompt structure.
Session isolation: Clear context on session end. No cross-session context leakage (session-based only).
Rate limiting: Per-user rate limit applies to context queries (same as Story 4.1).
Context preparation must complete within 500ms for optimal UX. Lazy summarization (only on query submission) helps.
LLM response time must not degrade due to context injection. Target: streaming start within 2s (same as non-context queries).
Large context (100+ messages) must be handled gracefully. Aggressive summarization if needed.
User should not see summarization process. All processing is transparent (possibly with subtle "thinking..." indicator).
Context clearing ("Start New Conversation") requires explicit user confirmation to prevent accidental data loss.

tests.standards: Follow test patterns from Story 4.1 (chat interface). Unit tests isolate hooks with mocks. Integration tests verify context is passed to LLM correctly. E2E tests verify end-to-end context flow: send question → send follow-up → verify context used → verify response is contextual. Test frameworks: Vitest + React Testing Library (frontend), pytest + FastAPI TestClient (backend). All tests must verify context isolation (no cross-session leakage) and performance (summarization < 500ms).
tests.locations: Frontend tests: apps/web/__tests__/ (Vitest discovers .test.tsx files). Backend tests: apps/api/tests/ (pytest discovers test_*.py files). E2E tests: apps/e2e/ (Playwright).
